svg.title: When to act, when to ask: Research · Llama 3.1 8B + LoRA
svg.desc: Fine-tuned an LLM to call the right tool or ask for clarification when a request is ambiguous. · Accuracy 60.9% → 70.9% · Clarification 80.5% → 95.1% · 110-query held-out set · github.com/Keerthirajan58/Tool-Ambiguity-in-LLMs
